items.title: John Mateer plants the OU flag on Texas, Baker Mayfield style
items.summary: Oklahoma upset No. 1 Texas 27-24 in the Red River Rivalry on a walk-off 47-yard field goal after a late Arch Manning interception. Quarterback John Mateer then waved and planted an Oklahoma flag in the end zone as Longhorns players walked past, adding a "Horns Down" for good measure. The clip, shared by On3, spread across X as fans compared it to Baker Mayfield's infamous 2017 flag plant at Ohio State.
